pages.title: Snake and Ladders
pages.creator: Catafractum
pages.description: Race to square 100 in Snake and Ladders, a board game where a dice roll can change the lead. Click or tap the die to move your piece along the numbered route. Ladders carry you ahead, while snakes send you back down the board. Rolling a six gives you another turn, so a lucky sequence can help you catch an opponent before the finish.

pages.title: Arrow Parking
pages.creator: Burning Goat Studio
pages.description: Arrow Parking turns a car's journey to its garage into a route-planning puzzle. Drag arrow tiles onto the board to lay out the directions the car should follow. Study the route before placing each tile and arrange the turns so the vehicle reaches its destination. Later parking puzzles become more demanding, giving you more to consider as you build a working path.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: In Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt, each shot helps you collect target bubbles and uncover crystals buried among the clusters. Aim the launcher with your mouse or touchpad and connect at least three matching colors to clear bubbles. The wall moves toward a boundary as play continues, leaving less room for mistakes. Use boosters and plan your shots to reach the crystals, raise your score, and keep the endless round going.

pages.title: My Happy farm
pages.creator: minigame
pages.description: My Happy farm puts you in charge of a farm where crops, equipment, and expansion compete for your resources. Move around with WASD or the arrow keys and use the mouse to select buttons. Decide where to invest as you develop the land, balancing work on crops with improvements to the farm. Managing what you have and choosing your next upgrade are central to building up the operation.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Story
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Search detailed scenes for the listed items in Hidden Objects Story. Tap an object when you spot it and work through the remaining targets before the timer expires. Wrong selections cost time, so careful searching matters as much as speed. Coins let you buy help: a compass narrows the search to an object's area, while a magnifying glass reveals the target directly. Each level adds another scene to the mystery.

pages.title: Fruit Jam
pages.creator: HeiTie
pages.description: Fruit Jam is a matching puzzle about turning fruit into glasses of juice. Select three identical fruits to prepare a drink, paying attention to the color of the fruit and its cup. Your task is to process all the fruit on the board. The puzzles grow harder as you progress, making the choice of your next matching set more important.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Bomb - 2Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Italian Brainrot Bomb - 2Player sends two rivals into a space hangar to compete for a dynamite bomb. Take it from the other player and keep possession until the countdown ends: the player holding it at that moment wins. Use WASD and the arrow keys to move the characters, chase the holder, or run away with the bomb as the final seconds approach.

pages.title: Hit ball
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hit ball combines ricochet shooting with waves of advancing monsters. Aim a volley so the balls rebound between walls and enemies, trying to eliminate every foe before it reaches the bottom. Battles include obstacles, traps, and bosses, while experience and ability choices help you develop your attacks. Aim and click with the mouse, or drag and release on a touchscreen. A useful angle can keep a volley hitting several targets before it returns.

pages.title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts asks you to organize colored nuts into matching stacks. Tap a bolt to select a nut, then choose an empty bolt or one with the same color to move it. Plan the order of your transfers so you keep enough space to separate mixed stacks. If a move blocks your progress, the undo option reverses it, while an extra bolt provides another place to work.

pages.title: Football Rush 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Take the ball down the pitch and aim for goal in Football Rush 3D. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, use the left mouse button to tackle, and hold it to shoot. The right mouse button passes the ball, while C changes the camera angle. Speed boosts and shots from different positions add to the action as you work toward another scoring opportunity.

pages.title: Wreck The Tower
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Wreck The Tower puts a tank opposite buildings that must be brought down with repeated shots. Fire at the structure until it collapses, watching the moving walls between you and your target. Hitting one of those barriers sends the bullet ricocheting back toward the tank. Choose your openings carefully as you demolish towers and unlock further areas.

pages.title: One HERO
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: One HERO is a shooting game built around one fighter facing successive waves of enemies. Move out of danger while firing back, clearing the opposition to continue the fight. Boss encounters add larger threats alongside the regular foes. Staying alive means balancing your attacks with movement, keeping the hero clear of incoming danger long enough to defeat the enemies on the battlefield.

pages.title: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls takes number merging onto an obstacle course. Guide a ball into others with the same value to combine them into a larger, differently colored ball. Start from two and keep doubling toward 2048 while steering away from spikes and the edges of the track. Slide to control the run, choosing a route that reaches matching numbers without sending the ball off the course.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks: Fill It Completely
pages.creator: GreeMead
pages.description: Fit differently shaped pieces into the outline in Puzzle Blocks: Fill It Completely. Drag blocks with the mouse or touchscreen and arrange them so the whole shape is covered without gaps. A piece that does not fit can be moved aside while you try another arrangement. Each level changes the shape and available blocks, with puzzles ranging from simple layouts to more demanding combinations.

pages.title: Battle Of Tank Steel
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive into combat in Battle Of Tank Steel, a tank shooting game centered on battlefield encounters. Use your tank's weapons to fight the opposition and work through the challenges ahead. Different tanks can be unlocked, bringing their own weapons and capabilities to the battle. Choosing among them gives you different equipment to use as you continue fighting.

pages.title: Car Fighter
pages.creator: Creative Antenna Entertainment LLP
pages.description: Build a small armed vehicle and send it into collision battles in Car Fighter. Choose wheels and weapons, then maneuver against a rival until you destroy its vehicle. Watch your own health bar as the machines crash together. Victories earn coins for new weapons and improvements, and a defeat sends you back to restart with another build. The parts you choose shape how your vehicle handles the next opponent.

pages.title: Pizza Maker - Cooking Games For Kids
pages.creator: Individual entrepreneur DENIS KLIMAV
pages.description: Prepare pizzas step by step in Pizza Maker - Cooking Games For Kids. Follow the prompts to choose ingredients, chop vegetables, grate cheese, and get the toppings ready. Work the dough, add sauce and toppings, then put the pizza in the oven. The game includes 15 recipes and finishes the cooking process by packing the pizza for delivery. Use the left mouse button or tap the screen to handle each task.

pages.title: Collect Honey Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Collect Honey Puzzle is a merge game in which small materials gradually become honey jars. Begin with sticks and work through upgrades to bricks, larger brick combinations, and eventually the containers needed to collect honey. Click or tap to play and keep building toward the next stage of the chain. Your score gives you a record to improve as you try another round.

pages.title: Bitball
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Bitball is a ball-and-tile game centered on building an in-game coin balance. Use the buttons down the right side to buy balls, then watch where they travel through the layout. The result changes your balance and determines what you can afford next. Start with a small amount and try to make it grow as you choose your next purchase.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Build descending card sequences in Spider Solitaire, working from kings down to aces. A complete run must contain every rank in the same suit before it can be removed. Organize the cards, uncover those still hidden, and work toward completing all eight sets from the two decks. Difficulty changes with the number of suits in play, making it harder to keep matching sequences together as more suits are introduced.

pages.title: Jail Prison Van Police Game
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Take a prison transport assignment in Jail Prison Van Police Game. As the officer at the wheel, your job is to drive the van and move its prisoners securely. Use W to accelerate, S to reverse, and A or D to steer. C changes the camera, H sounds the horn, and P or Escape pauses the game while you handle the transport route.

pages.title: Obby Flip
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Flip a ragdoll character across household obstacles and toward the bed in Obby Flip. Use the mouse or touchscreen to send Obby tumbling through the house, keeping the character away from the floor. Cash and diamonds along the route can help unlock other characters. Each level is another attempt to reach the bedroom by judging the next jump through the furniture and obstacles.

pages.title: Bike jump
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Bike jump begins with a high ramp and a target landing spot. Hold the mouse button to accelerate the motorcycle, then launch into the air from the ramp. Clicking during flight activates the jetpack, extending your control beyond the initial takeoff. Time the acceleration and airborne boost to carry the rider toward the target rather than relying on the launch alone.

pages.title: Chomp Chase
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a robot through the pixel maze in Chomp Chase, eating bits while keeping clear of the bugs. Use the arrow keys to turn through the corridors and collect as much as you can. Super bits make the robot invincible, letting it chomp the bugs that normally threaten the run. Watch their positions as you choose which part of the maze to visit next.

pages.title: Gymnastics Girls Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Gymnastics Girls Dress Up Game focuses on preparing a gymnast's appearance for a performance. Choose a glittering leotard and put together a matching makeover using the available fashion options. The wardrobe draws on rhythmic and artistic gymnastics styles, letting you try different stage looks. Click with the left mouse button to change the outfit and compare combinations before settling on the gymnast's final appearance.

pages.title: Basket Goal
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Basket Goal makes scoring a matter of moving puzzle pieces into the right positions. Shift the balls and the basket around the playing field until a ball reaches the hoop. The game has 100 levels with different arrangements to solve, plus coins that can unlock new balls. Look at the relationship between the basket and each ball before choosing your next move.

pages.title: Butterfly Kyodai HD
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Reunite matching wings in Butterfly Kyodai HD to form butterflies that fly off the board. A pair can connect only along a path with no more than two right-angle turns, so matching pictures may still be out of reach. Clear pairs before time expires. A shuffle rearranges the remaining wings, while the magic wand finds a pair when you need help spotting a valid connection.

pages.title: Car Wash Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Car Wash Rush is a runner in which the vehicle's cleanliness matters along the route. Guide the car through water to wash away the dirt, and steer clear of muddy patches that make it dirty again. Use the tap controls to manage its path. Watch the next stretch of road so a fresh wash is not immediately undone by driving through mud.

pages.title: Tower Boom
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Bring a structure down below the marked limit in Tower Boom. Pick up dynamite, place the charges on concrete sections of the tower, and press the detonator to set them off together. The resulting collapse follows the game's physics, so placement determines how the remaining pieces fall. Study the supports and distribute the explosives where they can bring the rubble low enough to finish the level.

pages.title: Idle Pinball Breakout
pages.creator: Fish Pond Studio
pages.description:
Idle Pinball Breakout blends bouncing-ball physics with brick breaking and idle progression. Improve your balls, adjust their physical properties, and upgrade the launcher to change how they work against the bricks. Gold earned through play feeds back into those improvements.

Boosters offer further ways to automate play, increase earnings, and alter the setup. The game also supports offline gold generation, with upgrades that can extend that earning period. Building a stronger configuration is as much a part of progress as watching the balls bounce through the field.

pages.title: Celebrity E-Girl Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together new looks for online fashion stars in Celebrity E-Girl Fashion. Choose makeup and outfits that fit the e-girl theme, trying different combinations as you update each character's appearance. Use the left mouse button to select the available styling options. The activity centers on the makeover and the finished fashion look, letting you experiment with the wardrobe and makeup choices.

pages.title: Sliding Slide
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Reassemble a picture by moving its blocks in Sliding Slide. Choose from six images and three difficulty settings, then tap the screen to shift the pieces toward their correct arrangement. The game records how quickly you solve the puzzle, giving you a completion time to improve. Study where each part of the picture belongs as you work toward restoring the full image.

pages.title: Pancake Tower 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a tall stack of pancakes as you travel along the route in Pancake Tower 3D. Add fruit toppings such as banana, strawberry, and blueberry, then deliver the pancakes to waiting guests. Traps and hungry characters along the road threaten the stack before it reaches them. Click or tap to control the run and keep your pancakes clear of trouble on the way to serving them.

pages.title: Baby Dragons
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Baby Dragons lets you give two little dragons their own makeovers. Try different wings, tails, clothing, and other appearance options to change how each creature looks. Tap the available choices and compare the combinations as you customize both dragons. The focus is on assembling their appearances, giving you two characters to style with the game's selection of dragon features and outfits.

pages.title: States Battle
pages.creator: CASUAL AZUR GAMES
pages.description: Command a growing territory in States Battle, a real-time strategy game about taking land from opposing armies. Click a target territory to launch a conquest, attack enemy positions, and work to overcome their towers. Your own land also needs defending as the battle develops. Decide where to push forward and where to protect what you hold while trying to take control of the map.

pages.title: Pokey Woman
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Stretch the character toward her boyfriend in Pokey Woman. Hold and drag to extend her leg, adjusting her reach as you work through the obstacles between them. Irons are hazards to keep clear of along the way. The puzzle revolves around the character's unusual stretching movement, making the placement of each extension more important than simply moving straight toward the goal.

pages.title: Super Heels
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Super Heels is a 3D runner built around collecting increasingly tall heels. Drag to move the character along the course and gather the footwear placed on the route. The growing heels are part of the parkour challenge as you approach the obstacles ahead. Look along the path before steering so you can line up with more heel pieces during the run.

pages.title: Tavern Master
pages.creator: PulseNova
pages.description: Build and run a medieval drinking house in Tavern Master. Buy tables and benches, arrange the furniture, and hire staff to serve your customers. Drinks are only part of the business: you can also equip a kitchen and put together a food menu. Use the mouse to handle purchases and management decisions, then expand the tavern to make room for more furniture and services as your plans grow.

pages.title: Flip Space Love Adventure
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide two characters toward a reunion in Flip Space Love Adventure, a pixel platform puzzle. Work around the platforms and obstacles so the boy can reach the girl's position. The characters can help each other cross the layout, including using one as a way to gain extra jumping height. Consider both positions when a route appears blocked and use their cooperation to reach the meeting point.

pages.title: Caveman Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Piece together a prehistoric picture in Caveman Jigsaw. Select Easy for a 24-piece puzzle or Hard for a 48-piece version, then drag each fragment to its correct place. A timer adds pressure to finish the image before the round ends. Compare the shapes and picture details as you sort the scattered pieces, using the mouse or touchpad to assemble the scene.

pages.title: Birds of Prey Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Birds of Prey Slide turns raptor pictures into sliding-tile puzzles. Choose one of three images and a grid size of 3 by 3, 4 by 4, or 5 by 5. Use the mouse to rearrange the tiles and rebuild the selected bird picture. Larger grids divide the scene into more fragments, giving you a more involved arrangement to solve.

pages.title: Asian Mystery
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Asian Mystery presents tic-tac-toe on a board drawn in golden sand. Place crosses and circles against a computer opponent, trying to complete your line while blocking its next opportunity. Choose the simple or complex mode to change the challenge. Click or tap to make a move, and collect victory points as you win rounds against the virtual rival.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Fruits Candies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Aim fruit-themed candies at matching groups in Bubble Shooter Fruits Candies. Release each shot toward similar candies to form combinations and work through the level's arrangement. Extra items and power-ups give you more ways to deal with difficult clusters. Use the mouse or touchpad to aim, looking for useful connections before sending the next candy into the field.

pages.title: Fun Kids Colors
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun Kids Colors pairs quick yes-or-no questions with colored pencils. Look at the pencil on screen and choose a response to its color question before moving on to the next one. The timer limits how many questions you can answer in a round. Click or tap the answer buttons, keeping your attention on the current pencil as you try to respond to as many prompts as possible.

pages.title: World Craft HD
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Shape a block-built world in World Craft HD. Use cubes to construct a house, lay out a garden, or work on a larger settlement across the available environments. WASD moves your character, the left mouse button removes blocks, and the right mouse button builds. You can reshape an area piece by piece, replacing parts of a design as your construction develops.

pages.title: City Bus Racing Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Steer a bus along streets and hill tracks in City Bus Racing Game. Press Play to begin, then use the left and right controls to guide the vehicle through the route. The game mixes road driving with off-road settings, giving you different stretches to navigate. Watch the path ahead and adjust the bus's direction as the terrain changes.

pages.title: Word Link
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Link letters to uncover words in Word Link. Use the mouse to swipe across letter blocks and form words that help solve the crossword puzzles. Finding the required answers advances the puzzle, while word building also earns coins. Examine the available letters and use the crossword clues to work out which combinations belong in the remaining spaces.

pages.title: Tank + Tank
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description: Tank + Tank combines vehicle merging with automated defense against alien invaders. Merge tanks to create stronger units, then place them on the battlefield where they attack the enemies themselves. Your role is to build up the force rather than aim every shot. Continue improving the tanks and sending them into battle to strengthen the defenses against the alien attack.

pages.title: Box Delivery Trucks Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Search delivery-truck scenes for hidden stars in Box Delivery Trucks Hidden. Each of the six levels contains ten targets to find before its timer runs out. Click or tap a star when you spot it and use the found counter to track what remains. Repeated rapid clicking can take time off the clock, so examine the picture carefully instead of sweeping it with random taps.

pages.title: Arkadium's Outspell
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Build words from a selection of random letters in Arkadium's Outspell. Decide which combinations to form and work toward a higher score by using the letters available to you. Difficulty settings range from easy to expert, giving you different challenges for your vocabulary. Look beyond the first word you notice and consider other combinations before committing to your next play.

pages.title: Pirates Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pirates Hidden Objects asks you to find the items pictured in a list on the left side of the screen. Examine the pirate scene and click or tap each matching object as you locate it. A timer keeps the search moving, and finishing before it expires earns bonus points. Use the list to keep track of the remaining targets as you clear the picture.

pages.title: Crazy PUBG PIXEL
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Fight to remain the last survivor in Crazy PUBG PIXEL, a block-style battle royale shooter. Explore the battlefield, pick up equipment, and use your weapons against the other combatants. WASD or the arrow keys move your character; the mouse aims and fires. Use R to reload, F to interact with doors and items, and Tab to open the inventory. Keep track of your equipment as you move between encounters.

pages.title: Zombie Attack
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Zombie Attack is a level-based shooting game in which you must eliminate zombies with a limited supply of ammunition. Tap to fire, watching both the magazine counter and the number of enemies still required for the level. Each shot uses another round, so aim carefully before spending it. Completing the target earns a star rating, with ammunition left over contributing to the result.

pages.title: Princess Pastel Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Choose soft-colored outfits for the princesses in Princess Pastel Fashion. Their wardrobes are built around pastel clothing, giving you dresses and other fashion options to combine into a finished look. Click through the choices to see how each outfit changes the character's appearance. Work with the color theme as you decide which pieces you want each princess to wear.

pages.title: Xtreme Offroad Truck 4x4 Demolition Derby 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Xtreme Offroad Truck 4x4 Demolition Derby 2020 combines rough-terrain driving with vehicle-smashing arena challenges. Take a 4x4 through off-road levels or move into demolition events, where destroying opposing cars earns points. Use WASD to drive and the space bar to brake. The two activities call for different approaches: navigating a route in one and lining up damaging collisions in the other.

pages.title: Unroll Ball
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Rearrange the tiles into a connected route in Unroll Ball. Use the mouse to slide or drag pieces until their paths fit together and create a way through for the ball. Look at how each section lines up with its neighbors before shifting it. The puzzle is solved by organizing the scattered route pieces into a continuous path.

pages.title: Tank Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Take a tank through city streets or across a desert map in Tank Simulator. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys and fire with the left mouse button. C changes the camera view, while F lets you enter or leave a vehicle. You can also press K to return directly to the tank. Explore the two settings and use the different views to guide the vehicle through its surroundings.

pages.title: Connect Hexas
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Rotate the six-sided pieces to join their paths in Connect Hexas. Tap a hexagon to change its orientation, then check whether its connections line up with the surrounding pieces. Each turn can affect more than one neighboring link, so consider the layout as a whole. The game offers Easy, Normal, and Hard puzzles built around making those connections fit together.

pages.title: Run Vovan Run
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Run Vovan Run is an endless runner with a click-to-jump control scheme. The character keeps moving while you choose when to leap over obstacles. Click or tap the screen to jump, then watch the next stretch of the route before jumping again. Try to keep Vovan running for as long as you can and improve your score.

pages.title: Xmas Panda Run
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Help a panda on its Christmas journey home in Xmas Panda Run. The character keeps running while you control its jumps and shots, using the up arrow to leap and the space bar to fire. Manage both actions as the journey continues, timing your inputs to keep the panda going toward its holiday reunion.

pages.title: Help The Duck
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help The Duck is a physics puzzle about getting a small yellow duck into a bathtub. Use the mouse to direct water and splash the duck toward the tub. The water's movement is part of the solution, so consider where to send it and how it will push the duck. Adjust your approach to guide the character into its destination.

pages.title: Mini Tanks
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Mini Tanks sets up an overhead duel between two tanks in an enclosed battlefield. Play against the computer or challenge another player, aiming to destroy the opposing tank before it destroys yours. Point with the mouse and fire with the left mouse button. The view lets you study the arena while choosing a direction for the next shot.

pages.title: Lof Fruits Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear the board by choosing matching endpoints in Lof Fruits Puzzles. Click or tap two identical fruits in one row or column to remove the fruit between them. Each choice changes which pairs remain available, and a careless removal can leave fruit you cannot clear. Plan several steps ahead and work toward an empty board rather than taking the first matching pair you see.

pages.title: Unlock Blox
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Make an exit route for the yellow block in Unlock Blox. Move the other blocks out of its way using the mouse or touchscreen, rearranging the board until the target piece can get through. Space is shared between the pieces, so one move may be needed before another becomes possible. Work out an order that opens the yellow block's path and lets you advance.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Dinosaur Park
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Join Hazel and her cousins on a visit to Baby Hazel Dinosaur Park. Help the children enjoy the different park zones by responding to their needs and taking part in the activities offered there. The outing includes games and surprise gifts as they explore. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel, the other children, and the objects involved in their day out.

pages.title: Mad Cop Police Car Race :Police Car vs Gangster Escape
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Race while police cars pursue you in Mad Cop Police Car Race :Police Car vs Gangster Escape. Take on driving challenges that combine finishing the race with handling the cars chasing behind. Some events require a minimum finishing position, so you must keep pace with the racers as well as watch for the police. Stay aware of your vehicle's health while navigating the roads and trying to reach the finish.

pages.title: Fabulous Cute Unicorn Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Fill unicorn illustrations with color in Fabulous Cute Unicorn Coloring Book. Choose from the palette's pastel shades using the selection bar on the right, then apply the colors to the drawing. The palette panel can be dragged with the left mouse button when you need to browse its options. Experiment with different shades to give the unicorn picture the appearance you want.

pages.title: Fast Menu Game
pages.creator: Frivgames.io
pages.description: Assemble customers' orders quickly in Fast Menu Game. Click ingredients to add them to the serving area, comparing your selection with the customer's request. When the ingredients match, click to hand over the order and move on to the next one. Speed contributes to your score, and the Earn Coins button provides more points while you keep up with the waiting customers.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Backyard Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help organize Hazel's first garden gathering in Baby Hazel Backyard Party. Prepare the venue, decorate the backyard, and handle the arrangements needed before everyone arrives. Once the party begins, make sure the guests are served and their needs are met. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the others as you move from setting up the backyard to looking after the gathering.

pages.title: Roloong
pages.creator: kpded
pages.description: Rotate a dragon's world in Roloong and use gravity to reach every mineral in the level. The left arrow turns the scene counterclockwise, while the right arrow turns it clockwise. Press a direction twice for a double rotation. Each turn changes how the dragon moves through the layout; U undoes the last move and R restarts the level when you want to try a different sequence.

pages.title: Speed Circular Racer
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Keep your car going around the circuit in Speed Circular Racer without crashing. The game is built around staying in motion for as long as possible, making each safe stretch part of a longer run. You can also play with a second player: one uses the mouse and the other uses the arrow keys. Watch the circuit as you try to extend your drive.

pages.title: Shooty Clocks
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Shooty Clocks turns moving clock hands into an aiming challenge. Wait until the active hand points toward another clock, then click to fire in that direction. Hitting a clock continues the chain, while a missed shot ends the attempt. Judge the hand's rotation before each click and try to link more successful shots together as the arrangement changes.

pages.title: Sheepop
pages.creator: stoneye
pages.description: Launch a sheep between small platforms in Sheepop. Touch the sheep, pull back to set up the jump, and release to send it through the air. Judge the direction and strength of the launch so it lands safely instead of falling into the water. Continue from one landing to the next and try to improve your record as you go.

pages.title: Block Riddle
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Block Riddle is a shape-fitting puzzle in which you complete a grid with the pieces provided. Drag each block into position and compare its outline with the spaces still open on the board. Power-ups can help when the arrangement leaves you stuck. Keep adjusting the placement of the pieces until they fit together and fill the puzzle grid.

pages.title: Airplane games
pages.creator: Rivera Games
pages.description: Guide a plane through obstacle-filled routes in Airplane games. Adjust its flight to keep clear of walls and other hazards while working through the game's stages, including snowy settings. The up and down arrow keys, or the corresponding on-screen controls, change the plane's vertical movement. Watch the space ahead and make corrections before the aircraft reaches a narrow passage.

pages.title: Boj Giggly Park Adventure
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Explore a park full of small activities in Boj Giggly Park Adventure. Meet Boj's friends and interact with different parts of Giggly Park, from riding a bicycle and using the swings to flying a kite or operating a remote-controlled helicopter. You can also climb a tree and dig for treasure. Characters including Mimi, Pops, Mr Cloppity, and Denzil appear around the park as you discover more things to do.

pages.title: Knife Hit Xmas
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Time your knife throws in Knife Hit Xmas, a Christmas-themed target game. Send knives toward the target while avoiding the blades and spikes already in the way. Clicking or touching triggers your actions, so wait for an opening before committing another throw. Collect diamonds during play and spend them on different knives as you continue working on your timing.

pages.title: Wrestle Jump
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Wrestle Jump is a physics-based wrestling game where scoring means driving your rival's head into the ground. Jump and use the wrestlers' momentum to turn the struggle in your favor, while trying to keep your own head from hitting first. The game includes a two-player option for a match with a friend. Each exchange depends on how the moving bodies land.

pages.title: Kuu Kuu Harajuku Stickers
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Make a character-filled sticker book in Kuu Kuu Harajuku Stickers. Drag G, Love, Angel, Music, and Baby into illustrated backgrounds from Harajuku City, arranging them where you want in each scene. Begin with the Clubhouse and continue with settings such as the studio, parks, and city skyline. Each background gives you another space to decorate with the show's characters.

pages.title: Super Dunk Line 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Draw a route for a falling basketball in Super Dunk Line 2. Use the mouse or touchscreen to sketch a line that guides the ball toward the basket, choosing both its shape and the moment to draw it. Avoid the troublesome balls that interfere with your attempt. Diamonds collected during play can be spent in the shop to unlock other basketballs.

pages.title: Miner Jump
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Climb the mine one jump at a time in Miner Jump. Tap to make the miner leap between platforms, working upward while avoiding the creatures in the shaft. The goal is to reach as high as you can and improve your score. Watch the next landing and the moving dangers before triggering another jump.

pages.title: Monster High Ear Doctor
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Purrsephone and Meowlody during their clinic visit in Monster High Ear Doctor. Both characters have ear problems, and you take the doctor's role in helping them through treatment. Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the game as you attend to the patients. The activity follows their shared visit and the ear-care tasks needed to help each character.

pages.title: Eugene and Rachel Magical Wedding
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a bride for her big day in Eugene and Rachel Magical Wedding. Rachel needs help choosing makeup and a wedding dress before marrying Eugene. Work through the available styling options and combine them into the bridal appearance you want. The game focuses on her preparations, letting you compare makeup and dress choices before settling on the finished wedding look.

pages.title: Let's Worm!
pages.creator: Stegobubbles
pages.description: Help a worm reach his kidnapped girlfriend in Let's Worm! Moles stand in the way, with attacks and projectiles threatening the route ahead. Tap to move the worm forward a step, choosing when to advance and when to wait for danger to pass. The story gives the journey its goal, while careful timing helps you get through the armed enemies' obstacles.

pages.title: Math Tracks
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Plan a route through numbered circles in Math Tracks. Drag the numbered square onto the circles to subtract their values from its total, aiming to bring the square's number to exactly zero. Choose the order of your moves by checking the values along the way. The game includes 20 levels, each giving you another arrangement of numbers to work through.

pages.title: Gun Shark Terror of Deep Water
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide an armed shark through a dangerous ocean in Gun Shark Terror of Deep Water. Eat fish, collect stars, and make use of weapon and health pickups while keeping clear of bombs and other threats. Collisions can drain the shark's life, so watch the health display as you swim. Mouse or touch controls let you manage the shark during the underwater run.

pages.title: The Halloween Shooter
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear a field of colored pumpkins in The Halloween Shooter. Tap to set the direction and launch a pumpkin toward others of the same color, forming groups that remove them from the level. Keep the growing arrangement away from the bottom boundary, where a pumpkin crossing the line ends the attempt. Study the colors and spaces before choosing the next shot.

pages.title: Princess Surprise Date
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help Belle arrange an outing with her boyfriend in Princess Surprise Date. Consider a beach visit, time in the park, or a meal at a restaurant, then choose clothing that fits the occasion. A swimsuit and pareo suit the beach, while a dress and heels fit the restaurant plan. The date setting gives you a theme for putting together her outfit.

pages.title: Last Deliver
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Keep a delivery worker clear of monsters in Last Deliver. Hold the mouse button to guide the character toward the pointer, moving through the route while trying to increase the delivery count. A baseball bat helps him fight back against the creatures. Stay aware of the approaching enemies and keep moving as you work to make another delivery.

pages.title: Cake Break
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Move cake pieces with blasts of force in Cake Break, a physics puzzle about reaching the goal. Click near a piece to create an impulse that pushes it across the terrain and into the air. Collect stars along the route and keep the cakes away from hazards that end the level. Every cake must reach the target, so consider how each blast will affect the pieces around it.

pages.title: Lappa Memory
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find matching picture pairs in Lappa Memory. Turn over cards to reveal their images and remember where each one appears. A matching pair is removed, while two different pictures turn face down again for another attempt. Work through the board by using what you have already seen, uncovering the remaining pairs until all of the cards are cleared.

pages.title: Princess Spring Closet
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Browse a princess's seasonal wardrobe in Princess Spring Closet. Choose clothing for a spring day and combine the available fashion items into an outfit. Try different pieces to see how they work together before deciding on the finished look. The closet provides the choices, while you handle the styling and help the princess get ready for the season.
